history.title: History of the Safavid Empire
history.subtitle: 1501 — 1736 · Two hundred thirty-five years of glory
history.intro: From young Ismail, who set Persia ablaze with faith and saber, to the great Abbas, who made Isfahan half the world — the Safavid Empire was the heart of the Silk Road, a cradle of art and a battlefield of great powers. This history is the backdrop of your game.

history_events.title: Birth of an Empire
history_events.text: Shah Ismail I enters Tabriz and proclaims the Safavid state. Shi'a Islam becomes the state religion — Persia takes on a new face.

history_events.title: Battle of Chaldiran
history_events.text: Ottoman Sultan Selim I the Grim inflicts Ismail's first defeat. The Empire endures, but its eternal rivalry with the Ottomans is sealed.

history_events.title: The Capital Moves
history_events.text: Tahmasp I moves the court from vulnerable Tabriz to Qazvin. The frontiers pulse with war in the west and the east alike.

history_events.title: The Rise of Abbas
history_events.text: Sixteen-year-old Abbas I the Great takes the throne. He will forge a new army — the 'regiments of the shah' — and restore the empire's might.

history_events.title: Isfahan, Half the World
history_events.text: Abbas moves the capital to Isfahan. The Naqsh-e Jahan square, turquoise domes and bazaars turn the city into legend: 'Isfahan is half the world.'

history_events.title: The Return of Tabriz
history_events.text: Abbas I retakes Azerbaijan and Tabriz, shattering the Ottoman armies. The empire reaches its military zenith.

history_events.title: Masters of the Trade Routes
history_events.text: Kandahar is taken, the Portuguese are expelled from Hormuz. Persian silk flows to Europe; the treasury fills with the gold of the Great Silk Road.

history_events.title: The Fall of Isfahan
history_events.text: Afghan tribes of Mahmud Hotak take the capital after a long siege. The golden age ends in famine and fire.

history_events.title: Twilight of the Safavids
history_events.text: Nader Shah is crowned the new ruler of Persia. The Safavid dynasty passes into history — but its art endures for centuries.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.subtitle: Report a bug, share an idea, ask about balance or donations. Only the game team sees your message.
feedback.placeholder: Describe the issue in detail — at least 10 characters
feedback.success: Message sent! We read every message — its status and any reply will appear here.
feedback.login_needed: Sign in to send a message
feedback.min_len: Please add more detail — at least 10 characters
feedback.hint_bug: Tell us where (city or location), what you were doing, how to reproduce it and what you expected to see. The console error text (F12) speeds things up a lot.
feedback.hint_idea: Describe the problem your idea solves, not only the solution itself. Say who it helps and whether it breaks anything that already works.
feedback.hint_balance: Name the specific item, class or skill and give the numbers: damage, price, time. Explain why it doesn't add up right now.
feedback.hint_donation: Write the date and amount of the purchase and what exactly is missing. Add the order number from the confirmation email if you have one. Never share card details, CVC or SMS codes.
feedback.hint_account: Give your login and linked email. Your password is never needed and must not appear in the text. If your account was stolen, say so in the very first sentence.
feedback.hint_other: Briefly: what the question is and what you want to get out of it.
feedback.routing_private: Feedback is for bugs, money, accounts and anything that concerns only you. Only the team sees it.
feedback.routing_forum: Questions useful to every player belong on the forum:

site.faq_free_a: Yes! Empire of Safavids is completely free. All items, content and features are available for free. We do not sell gameplay advantages for real money.
site.faq_pvp_a: Yes! PvP arena, open-world PvP in certain zones, territory control raids, and the weekly Divan of the Shah for top-10 players.
site.faq_minigames_a: Yes! Chess of the Shah (6×6 chess with gold bets), Poetry of Hafiz (poetry mini-game), and the in-game encyclopedia Chronicles of the Safavids.
site.faq_req_a: Any modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge). 2 GB RAM, stable internet. Node.js 18+ required for local server.
site.faq_languages_q: What languages is the game in?
site.faq_languages_a: Russian, English, Azerbaijani. Language can be switched at any time.
